scope: Frozen author-created engineering fixtures, not held-out professional labels or a model benchmark.

cases.requested_outcome: Resolve the customer issue and obtain their confirmation.
cases.source_text: The service failed. Repair or an approved alternative might resolve it. No remedy has yet been confirmed.
cases.review_focus: Two candidate paths must remain alternatives, not be treated as tasks both necessarily required.

cases.requested_outcome: Resolve the customer issue and obtain their confirmation.
cases.source_text: The desired result is known but no mandatory condition has been selected.
cases.review_focus: No success expression must not mean success by default.

cases.requested_outcome: Resolve the customer issue within authorised budget.
cases.source_text: No expenditure is currently authorised. The proposed remedy has a stated cost.
cases.review_focus: Separate no compatible enumerated route from proof that no real-world option exists.

cases.source_text: A call was completed, but there is no recorded evidence that the customer accepted the remedy.
cases.review_focus: Completed work must not become a successful result.

cases.source_text: Two reviewed fixture sources give opposite accounts of whether issue scope is understood.
cases.review_focus: A reviewer or model cannot average away a factual dispute.

cases.requested_outcome: Maintain an available remedy and obtain accepted resolution.
cases.source_text: One candidate action claims to resolve the issue but also removes the remedy required by the objective. The budget cannot fund both remedy options to restore it afterwards.
cases.review_focus: Forward simulation must not ignore a destructive effect on a mandatory outcome.

cases.requested_outcome: Resolve the issue before the stated deadline.
cases.source_text: The deadline has already elapsed and no acceptance has been recorded.
cases.review_focus: A positive route duration cannot fit an expired deadline.

cases.requested_outcome: Customer confirms resolution, not merely receipt of an offer.
cases.source_text: The customer has not accepted. Sending an offer is not the required outcome.
cases.review_focus: Deliberate semantic defect: this graph targets sending an offer instead of obtaining acceptance. Structural validity cannot certify meaning.
